about: Every foreground/background colour pair the page draws, by token (src/template.html :root, and src/save/style.css :root for the dev build), and the pairs the emails draw ("build": "email", from src/worker/email-style.js's DRAWN_PAIRS; test M20). Measured by `npm run contrast` with APCA (apca-w3); a pair fails when |Lc| is under its role's minimum.

body.means: text under 24px, or under 18.66px when bold (700)

large-text.means: text at 24px or more, or 18.66px or more at 700

ui-or-heading.means: a UI component's boundary or state, or a large heading (30px+ at 700)

non-text.means: a non-text accent: a plan's colour bar, the orange rule

considered_not_drawn.why: the store's own button (white on its orange): measured, and under 60 even at 19px/700
option A, navy text on the store's orange: under 60
near-black on the store's orange: passes by 0.6, and loses the store's white label
option B, chosen: the same orange family darkened (hsl 28 100% 42%) keeps the store's white uppercase label

not_measured.why: the unfilled track under a ring's arc (SPEC-every-menu-and-nutrition § 11 item 4.1, the store's own #eceef0): decoration beside a printed number and its label (--ink on --white, measured above), carrying nothing a visitor must find

not_measured.as: the halftone's dots on --ink (E1's band and footer, SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass § 8)
not_measured.why: the flyer's own halftone colour (print/print.css .fb-dots), drawn as a texture by the email's tile (src/assets/email/halftone-ink.png, npm run email:images): one dot of 1 px radius every 9 px, 4% of the area, behind the words. The words are measured on the ground the texture lies on (--ink, above); over a dot's core, measured and not gating: --white Lc -88.5, --signature -43.2, --lean -34.7, --line -69.9 (§ 8.1)

not_measured.as: the halftone's dots on --cta (E1's panel, § 8 item 3)
not_measured.why: the panel's texture (src/assets/email/halftone-cta.png): the same grid, its dot the darker orange, so the white label is measured on --cta (above) and is clearer still over a dot (--on-cta on --cta-hover, Lc -75.4)
